author: leMaCderp
body:
i prefer to call it a team, not a clan.

i dont want to write an essay, but heres a summary of me

postitive things about me
- i can pvp decently
- i can play any role
- i can cannon well (if theres cannoning)
- OCN player
- active
- im a true lad
- will listen to instructions

not-so-positive things about me
- i dont have ts ( i do have skype and mumble though)
- australian (ping, timezone)
- new to server, not a lot of experience
- maturity depends on the overall maturity level of the people im around
- can get very paranoid
- horrible at a bow (close range bow 1v1s, but i can do long shots)

note : i do not want to join a team with a majority of OCN players, i want to join a team with a majority of avicus players
